title: Conditioning Shrink Taken Against Bushels Held in Store
content:
Water leaving the grain and the handling loss that goes with it take bushels off what the member has in store, and they are taken off in one line against the storage account rather than charged for. This entry governs conditioning shrink on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The provision

The bushels taken off for shrink are fixed only after the storage account carries a conditioning charge raised on the day the bushels are taken off, since the shrink follows the pass that caused it.

The line the desk records names the bushels the shrink was worked out on, the points of moisture it covers and the bushels taken off, and those bushels come off what the account shows in store from that moment. No money moves, since shrink is a loss of grain rather than a charge, and the standing of the agreement and its grade of record are untouched.

## The clause restated

The quantity to be taken off is not yet fixed while the storage account for that day carries no conditioning charge; once a conditioning charge stands on the account bearing the same date as the shrink line, the quantity is fixed and the line is taken.

## Recording the shrink

The recording tool is `record_conditioning_shrink_cafcaf64`. It is a hidden tool of the elevator's own: the desk unlocks it and then calls it itself, the loss being one the cooperative's own plant took off the lot.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agreement_id` | the internal reference number of the storage agreement the bushels are held under | as returned by the storage agreement lookup for this member |
| `bushels` | the quantity the shrink was worked out on | bushels to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the second decimal |
| `points_removed` | the moisture this shrink line covers | percentage points to 1 decimal place, rounded half up at the first decimal, never negative |
| `shrink_bushels` | the quantity taken off what is held in store | bushels to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the second decimal, never negative |

### What comes back

A single line of confirmation text carrying the new storage account line's own reference, the bushels the shrink was worked out on, the points covered and the bushels taken off, all in bushels to 2 decimal places. Receiving that line means the shrink stands on the member's storage account and the bushels it names are off what the account shows in store.

## Basis questions answered

**Does any money move?** None. Shrink is a loss of grain, and the line carries no amount.

**Does the grade of record move?** It does not, nor does the standing of the agreement.
